card.name: Study numbers in clinical trial names
card.fires_on: Pieces of clinical study identifiers and numbers, such as the hyphen or digits inside codes like GS-98-437, or the space before a list of study numbers. Also fires on 'not' in 'did not extend beyond 24 weeks' in antiepileptic trial text.
